outcome.description: After a nonjury trial the Court of Claims largely adopted the State's appraisal (rejecting its 80% discount on the R-10 portion), found direct damages of $71,000 ($54,000 NB portion, $17,000 R-10 portion), and entered judgment for the principal sum of $113,730 including other damages not itemized in the decision. The Appellate Division, Second Department affirmed on May 4, 2022.

source.caseName: J. Nazzaro Partnership, L.P. v. State of New York
source.court: Supreme Court of the State of New York, Appellate Division, Second Department, on appeal from the Court of Claims
source.excerptNote: Verbatim from the facts portion of the decision (property, taking, Chase ground lease, and each side's highest-and-best-use and appraisal evidence at the nonjury trial). Removed: the opening paragraph (judgment amount and decretal paragraph), the Court of Claims' findings and the resulting damages and judgment figures, and all legal analysis. A page marker ([*2]) was removed. The judgment includes 'other damages not challenged on appeal' that the decision does not itemize, so the input has no evidence on those components. Official reporter copy: nycourts.gov reporter, 2022 NY Slip Op 02984.
